A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the Kalai-Vempala algorithm of FPL is a universal tool for online learning.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the algorithm of following the leader with a perturbed weights can work well for the case of unbounded losses.
the performance of the algorithm is optimal in the class of games where one-step losses of the experts have a small scaled fluctuation.
it is possible to design an online learning algorithm which has the optimal performance for the case of unbounded loss functions.
